_meta.scope: Curated ~80 commonly-imported consumer-goods HS lines for Pikau demo. Not the full schedule. Always confirm against the live NZ Working Tariff for any operational classification.

fields.hs_code: HS 10-digit NZ tariff line (8-digit headings shown where 10-digit is not yet differentiated for the demo).
fields.description: Plain-English summary of the tariff line.
fields.duty_general: General rate, NZD or % ad valorem.
fields.duty_preferences: Selected FTA preference rates. Where the line is 'Free' under general rate, all FTAs follow.
fields.keywords: Lower-case substrings used for pre-flight matching against user messages.

_meta.fta_notes: Preferential rates require a valid Certificate of Origin or self-declaration plus compliance with each FTA's Rules of Origin (RCEP / CPTPP / NZ-China / NZ-UK / PACER Plus). Cumulation rules vary.

entries.description: Coffee, roasted, not decaffeinated
entries.biosecurity_flag: MPI IHS for processed plant products — phytosanitary certificate generally not required for fully roasted coffee but check importer registration.
entries.notes: GST 15% applies on VFD + freight + duty.

entries.description: Black tea (fermented), in immediate packings of ≤ 3 kg
entries.biosecurity_flag: MPI IHS for plant products — declarations required if loose-leaf with stems.
entries.notes: Confirm wrapper material under GIR 5(b) for retail packaging classification.

entries.description: Chocolate, in blocks/slabs/bars, not filled, ≤ 2 kg
entries.biosecurity_flag: MPI: dairy-containing products may need additional clearance from approved manufacturing facility.
entries.notes: Distinguish from filled chocolate (1806.31.00) — filled = higher duty band typically.

entries.description: Sweet biscuits
entries.biosecurity_flag: MPI IHS for baked goods — ingredient declaration required (egg, dairy).
entries.notes: Check claim register if marketed as 'low sugar' (FSANZ Code requirements).

entries.description: Apple juice, not concentrated
entries.biosecurity_flag: MPI: pasteurisation evidence required.
entries.notes: Brix value drives sub-heading; declare on commercial invoice.

entries.description: Wine of fresh grapes, in containers ≤ 2L, not sparkling, 14% vol. or less

duty_preferences.all: Free customs duty; excise-equivalent applies regardless

entries.biosecurity_flag: MPI: must be from an approved exporter for some origins.
entries.notes: Excise-equivalent duty applies. GST 15% on VFD + freight + duty + excise.

entries.description: Beer made from malt, in containers ≤ 2L

duty_preferences.all: Free customs duty; excise-equivalent applies regardless

entries.notes: Excise rate depends on alcoholic strength. Confirm ABV on label.

entries.description: Beauty/make-up/skin-care preparations (incl. moisturisers, foundations, lipsticks)
entries.notes: EPA notification may apply if product contains substances scheduled under HSNO.

entries.description: Shampoos
entries.notes: Conditioners classified separately under 3305.90.

entries.description: Perfumes and toilet waters
entries.notes: Alcohol content >24% may attract excise — flag for review.

entries.description: Soap and organic surface-active products, for toilet use, in bars
entries.notes: Liquid soap in 3401.20.00.

entries.description: Sacks and bags of polymers of ethylene (plastic carry bags)
entries.notes: Single-use plastic bag ban (Plastic Shopping Bag Regs 2018) — confirm end-use is not banned.

entries.description: Tableware and kitchenware of plastics
entries.notes: Food-contact compliance: FSANZ Standard 1.4.3.

entries.description: Handbags, with outer surface of leather or composition leather
entries.biosecurity_flag: MPI: leather goods require declaration; suede/untanned leather may need treatment cert.
entries.notes: Rules of Origin under CPTPP often require chapter-change for leather inputs.

entries.description: Handbags, outer surface of plastic sheeting or textile materials
entries.notes: Distinguish from 4202.21 by predominant outer-surface material (GIR 3(b)).

entries.description: Trunks, suitcases, vanity cases, briefcases with outer surface of plastics or textile
entries.notes: Hard-shell vs soft-shell — both fall under 4202.12 if outer surface is plastic/textile.

entries.description: Articles normally carried in pocket/handbag, outer surface plastic/textile (wallets, card holders)
entries.notes: Leather-outer equivalents in 4202.31.

entries.description: Toilet paper
Printed books, brochures, leaflets
entries.notes: GST 15% still applies on imports unless de minimis.

entries.description: Newspapers, journals and periodicals, not appearing at least four times a week
Trade advertising material, commercial catalogues
T-shirts, singlets, other vests, knitted or crocheted, of cotton
entries.notes: Apparel duty bands are higher than most consumer goods — preference status matters a lot.

entries.description: Women's or girls' trousers, breeches, shorts of cotton, woven
entries.notes: Yarn-forward rule under CPTPP — origin requires that yarn was spun in a CPTPP party.

entries.description: Men's or boys' trousers, breeches, shorts of cotton, woven
entries.notes: Yarn-forward rule under CPTPP.

entries.description: Jerseys, pullovers, cardigans, knitted or crocheted, of cotton
Men's or boys' overcoats, raincoats, anoraks, ski-jackets of man-made fibres
Footwear with outer soles and uppers of rubber or plastics (sneakers, sandals)
Footwear with outer soles of rubber/plastic and uppers of leather
entries.biosecurity_flag: MPI: leather uppers — declaration required.

entries.description: Footwear with outer soles of rubber/plastic and uppers of textile materials
Hats and other headgear, knitted or crocheted
Glassware for table/kitchen, other than of glass-ceramics
entries.notes: Lead crystal in 7013.91 carries different rate.

entries.description: Table, kitchen or other household articles of stainless steel
entries.notes: Food-contact compliance applies (FSANZ 1.4.3).

entries.description: Table, kitchen or other household articles of aluminium
Spoons, forks, ladles, skimmers, and similar kitchen/tableware
Spades and shovels (hand tools)
entries.biosecurity_flag: MPI: used garden tools must be clean of soil.

entries.description: Screwdrivers
Hand pumps, other than pumps of subheading 8413.11/8413.19
Combined refrigerator-freezers, fitted with separate external doors
entries.notes: MEPS (Minimum Energy Performance Standards) registration required under Energy Efficiency Act 2000.

entries.description: Dishwashing machines, household type
entries.notes: WaterMark / WELS registration may apply.

entries.description: Washing machines, fully-automatic, of dry linen capacity ≤ 10 kg
entries.notes: MEPS + WELS registration required.

entries.description: Portable automatic data processing machines, weight ≤ 10 kg (laptops, tablets)
entries.notes: Radio Spectrum Management compliance (Wi-Fi/BT) — supplier declaration acceptable.

entries.description: Smartphones
entries.notes: Radio Spectrum compliance applies.

entries.description: Machines for reception/transmission of voice/images (routers, modems, Wi-Fi APs)
entries.notes: Radio Spectrum compliance applies.

entries.description: Headphones and earphones, whether or not combined with microphone
Video recording or reproducing apparatus (set-top boxes, media players)
Reception apparatus for television (TVs), other than cathode-ray
entries.notes: MEPS registration required.

entries.description: Electronic integrated circuits — processors and controllers
Syringes, needles, catheters and the like for medical use
entries.notes: Medsafe / WAND registration required for medical devices.

entries.description: Medicaments consisting of mixed or unmixed products for therapeutic uses, in measured doses
entries.notes: Medicines Act 1981: requires Medsafe consent. Controlled drugs Schedule check.

entries.description: Seats with wooden frames, upholstered
entries.biosecurity_flag: MPI IHS: wooden articles require ISPM 15-treated packaging and supplier biosecurity declarations.
entries.notes: Risk-good: declarations of wood treatment required to avoid hold and inspection.

entries.description: Wooden furniture of a kind used in offices
entries.biosecurity_flag: MPI IHS for wooden articles — fumigation / heat-treatment declarations required.

entries.description: Wooden furniture of a kind used in the bedroom
entries.biosecurity_flag: MPI IHS for wooden articles — treatment evidence required.

entries.description: Mattresses (other than of cellular rubber or plastics)
entries.notes: Flammability standards — refer NZ Standards AS/NZS 4220.

entries.description: Tricycles, scooters, pedal cars, dolls' carriages, dolls, other toys; reduced-size models
entries.notes: Product safety standards under Fair Trading Act — small parts, choking hazards.

entries.description: Video game consoles and machines, other than those of subheading 9504.30
entries.notes: Radio Spectrum compliance for wireless controllers.

entries.description: Bicycles and other cycles, not motorised
entries.biosecurity_flag: MPI: used bicycles must be clean of soil and plant material.
entries.notes: NZTA reflector/light requirements apply at point of sale.

entries.description: Motorcycles with electric motor for propulsion (e-motorbikes, including e-scooters above certain power)
entries.notes: Battery transport — IMDG Class 9 UN3480/UN3481. Clean Car Discount may apply.

entries.description: Inflatable balls (footballs, rugby balls, basketballs, soccer balls)
Articles and equipment for general physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics
Wrist-watches, electrically operated, with case of precious metal
entries.notes: AML/CFT considerations on high-value imports.

entries.description: Wrist-watches, electrically operated, with mechanical display only
Articles of jewellery of other precious metal (gold, platinum)
entries.notes: AML/CFT obligations for dealers. Valuation: WTO Method 1 from transaction value.

entries.description: Imitation jewellery, of base metal
entries.notes: Lead-content product safety requirements.

entries.description: New pneumatic tyres of rubber, of a kind used on motor cars
entries.biosecurity_flag: MPI: used tyres require IHS clearance and may be biosecurity risk.
entries.notes: Tyre Stewardship levy applies on entry into NZ market.

entries.description: Brakes and servo-brakes for motor vehicles
Other parts and accessories of motor vehicles
entries.biosecurity_flag: MPI: used parts must be clean of soil/plant material.
entries.notes: Confirm whether item is specifically classified elsewhere first (GIR 1).

entries.description: Dog or cat food, put up for retail sale
entries.biosecurity_flag: MPI IHS for pet food — variable by ingredient origin. Often requires veterinary certification.
entries.notes: Risk-good: many pet food imports require permit + MPI BACC clearance.

entries.description: Wood sawn or chipped lengthwise, of thickness > 6 mm, of non-coniferous species
entries.biosecurity_flag: MPI: high biosecurity risk — IHS for sawn wood requires fumigation, kiln-drying, or alternative treatment per species.
entries.notes: CITES check for restricted species (e.g., Dalbergia).

entries.description: Basketwork, wickerwork and other articles of vegetable plaiting materials
entries.biosecurity_flag: MPI IHS for plant-based articles — high biosecurity risk; treatment evidence required.
entries.notes: Risk-good: frequent hold/inspection.

entries.description: Tableware and kitchenware of wood — bread boards, chopping boards, etc.
entries.biosecurity_flag: MPI IHS for wooden articles — treatment evidence required.

entries.description: Candles, tapers and the like
entries.notes: Beeswax candles — confirm bee origin (HS 0410.90 for raw beeswax).

entries.description: Other household articles of plastics
Manicure or pedicure preparations
entries.notes: Flammable liquid — IMDG check for shipping (often UN1263 PAINT).

entries.description: Articles for Christmas festivities
entries.biosecurity_flag: MPI: natural Christmas trees/wreaths — high biosecurity risk; permit required.

entries.description: Mechano-therapy appliances; massage apparatus
entries.notes: If medical claim, Medsafe registration likely required.

entries.description: Glaziers' putty, grafting putty, resin cements, caulking compounds, painters' fillings
entries.notes: EPA HSNO check for hazardous substances.

entries.description: Paints and varnishes (incl. enamels and lacquers) in a non-aqueous medium
entries.notes: IMDG: solvent-based paints often UN1263 Class 3 flammable liquid.

entries.description: Electric coffee or tea makers
entries.notes: Electrical Safety Compliance under Electricity (Safety) Regulations 2010.

entries.description: Other hair-dressing apparatus (hair dryers excluded — 8516.31)
DC motors and generators, of output ≤ 750 W (small electric motors)
Electrical plugs and sockets, for a voltage ≤ 1000V
entries.notes: AS/NZS 3112 compliance required for sale in NZ.
